verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a processor (SoC), and a chip has no data or interface of its own in which to surface AI-generated insights, so this story does not fit its product category. The evidence only covers performance claims, such as on-device Apple Intelligence models running fast on the Neural Engine and support for running large LLMs. Apple Intelligence is OS software that runs on the chip, not a capability the chip itself ships, so the exception for an otherwise wrong-axis capability does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
